reuse.why: Replaces the per-action category queries with one getMonthActionCategories helper and one isSkippedByMonthActions predicate, and the new action reuses getSheetValue/setBudget and the existing registration pattern.

duplication.why: The exclusion rule now lives in one predicate; the remaining repetition is the per-action income/tracking check and the expense-sign flip, which the new action re-writes as 0 - activity alongside the existing avg *= -1.

placement.why: Selection rules sit in budget/actions.ts next to the actions that use them and the handler is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Focused on month-wide actions, their registration and tests, plus release notes.

maintainability.why: A single predicate with an explicit includeHiddenCategories parameter is easy to own, though copyPreviousMonth still has its own query feeding the predicate and the income rule stays outside it.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions route through isSkippedByMonthActions (directly or via getMonthActionCategories).

disguised_duplication.where: The only repeated logic, the expense sign flip in setLastMonthSpending, is a small open re-write, not a disguised copy.

abstraction_drift.where: isSkippedByMonthActions/getMonthActionCategories gain only the includeHiddenCategories parameter the request asks for; every action calls them.
